transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the critical importance of security and privacy in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted, safeguarding sensitive user data. TRU-02 focuses on secure PIN authentication, which is essential for access control. TRU-03 mandates logging of transactions for auditability, while TRU-04 prevents negative balances, promoting data integrity. TRU-05 allows users to review their history securely, and TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds before withdrawals. Lastly, TRU-07 maintains data integrity by validating operations against business rules. These requirements collectively protect user data and maintain trust in the system.

transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the need for ethical standards and compliance in the ATM system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, safeguarding user interests. RES-02 mandates comprehensive transaction logs for accountability and transparency. RES-03 prevents negative balances, promoting fairness in financial interactions. RES-04 addresses secure PIN verification, supporting user accountability. RES-05 ensures funds are only withdrawn when available, aligning with responsible financial practices. RES-06 guarantees immediate user notifications for insufficient funds, enhancing fairness. Lastly, RES-07 emphasizes user privacy, ensuring ethical handling of personal data. These requirements collectively uphold ethical standards and compliance in the ATM system.

transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I emphasize the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-01 aims to minimize energy consumption through optimized transaction processing, aligning with environmental goals. GRN-02 ensures transparency by providing a carbon footprint report for each transaction, promoting awareness. GRN-03 advocates for energy-efficient hardware, reducing ecological impact. GRN-04 focuses on minimizing data storage requirements, which can also lower energy use. GRN-05 offers electronic transaction records, reducing paper waste. GRN-06 promotes energy savings by shutting down during inactivity, and GRN-07 assesses the environmental impact annually for accountability. These requirements collectively foster a sustainable ATM operation.

transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I emphasize the critical importance of safety and reliability in the ATM system. SAF-01 ensures that no account can have a negative balance, protecting users from financial risk. SAF-02 mandates automatic fund withdrawal from savings to avoid transaction failures, enhancing reliability. SAF-03 ensures users are informed and transactions terminate safely if funds are insufficient, preventing user confusion. SAF-04 requires comprehensive transaction logging for accountability. SAF-05 mandates secure PIN verification to ensure only authorized access. SAF-06 allows safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 provides users with a clear account summary post-transaction. These requirements collectively enhance the safety and reliability of the ATM system.

transcript.statement: As the EfficiencyAgent, I emphasize the importance of performance efficiency in the ATM system. requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure no account can have a negative balance during transactions.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account only when sufficient funds are available.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance for auditability.
The ATM system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances, including notifications post-attempt.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption during transaction processing while ensuring user responsiveness.
The ATM system shall provide a mechanism for users to receive electronic transaction records.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: These requirements all focused on transaction logging, creating redundancy.
The automatic fund withdrawal and user notifications need to coexist without conflict.
Energy efficiency and transaction speed can be balanced through optimized guidelines.
